title: Setting Up Your School Identity
description: Learn how to configure your school profile, upload logos, set up official stamps and signatures, and activate academic cycles.
steps: 1. Go to Settings -> School Profile and fill out school identity details.
2. Upload PNG images of your school logo, principal signature, and school stamp.
3. Click Save Profile to apply the configuration globally across all PDF receipts.

title: Managing Classes & Creating Fee Structures
description: Step-by-step video guide to enrolling classes, allocating sections, and building default fee templates for academic terms.
steps: 1. Click Classes in the sidebar to add class rooms and section mappings.
2. Go to Settings -> Fee Structure and select the class to configure.
3. Add default fee items (Tuition Fee, Exam Fee) and save the templates to distribute dues automatically.

title: Broadcasting WhatsApp Reminders & Bot Login
description: Mastering parent notifications: setting automated schedulers, reviewing logs, and linking your mobile Principal Bot.
steps: 1. Open WhatsApp Reminders page to view current pending stats.
2. Configure reminder schedules (IST time and frequency) and turn on automated dispatch.
3. Connect WhatsApp Bot by creating an activation command and password under settings.
